title: 第19章 各怀鬼胎第20章 动我的男人你问过我了吗
slug: 一剑惊天下可她身后的男人更可怕
content_zh:
待陈村长几人退出房间，脚步声渐远，君傲使了个眼色。
阿青会意，身形在屋内快速游走，纤指如蝶翻飞，一道道隐晦的符文被她凌空刻下，没入墙壁、地面和门扉。
阿水则从怀中取出几面小巧的阵旗，精准地插在房间四角。
片刻后，一层几乎不可察的淡蓝色光晕如水波般漾开，将整个房间笼罩在内。
“隔音阵和预警阵都布好了。”阿青舒了口气，“外面现在听不到我们的声音，若有人靠近三丈之内，阵法也会示警。”
阿水立刻凑到君傲跟前，眼睛瞪得溜圆：“世子，你到底怎么发现他们是扶桑人的？还学人家说话，装得跟真的似的！”
怀安也好奇地望过来。
君傲摸了摸鼻子，一本正经道：“本世子天赋异禀，对鬼子有天生的嗅觉——一进村就觉得浑身难受，恶心反胃，这还能有假？”
阿青：“……”
阿水：“……”
怀安：“……”
这理由简直离谱到让人无法反驳。
“好了，说正事。”君傲收起玩笑神色，压低声音，“我大概猜到了——鬼子为什么会选中这么个偏僻村子。”
他顿了顿，一字一句道：“因为这里，有源石矿脉。”
“源石矿脉？！”阿水倒吸一口凉气。
阿青脸色也凝重起来：“难怪……源石是炼制高品丹药、铸造神兵、乃至辅助修炼的顶级资源。大武境内已知的源石矿脉，几乎都掌握在朝廷和几大顶级宗门手里。若让扶桑人偷偷开采一批……”
“他们就能在短时间内，培养出大批高阶鬼武者。”君傲接过话头，眼神冰冷，“到那时再入侵大武，代价会小得多。”
怀安握紧拳头：“绝不能让他们得逞！”
“当然不能。”君傲在桌边坐下，手指轻敲桌面，“但眼下硬拼不是办法。矿场那边有两个超凡境坐镇。除此之外，看守矿脉的鬼武者肯定不少，第九境的恐怕也有好几个。”
他看向阿水：“我们这边，只有你和阿青是超凡。打起来或许能赢，但万一对方狗急跳墙，毁了矿脉，或者我们有人折损，都不划算。”

阿水立刻明白：“世子的意思是……求援？”
“对。”君傲点头，“用传讯玉牌联系映雪。把这里的情况告诉她——落霞村、源石矿脉、两名扶桑超凡，还有我们四个的位置。请她……亲自来一趟。”
阿水没有犹豫，立刻从怀中取出一枚巴掌大小、温润剔透的玉牌。
她指尖凝起一缕真气，在玉牌表面快速划动，留下淡淡的光痕。
信息写完，玉牌微光一闪，恢复原状。
“消息发出去了。”阿水道。
与此同时，村子另一头的“村长家”正屋内。
烛火摇曳，映着几张阴沉的脸。
陈村长，此刻他已撕下伪装，露出一张四十余岁、留着短须的扶桑面容。
跪坐在主位上，下方是三名心腹。
“山本君，那小子……真是‘影将’派来的？”一名脸上带疤的武士低声问，“令牌不假，扶桑语也纯正，但他身边那两个女人，气息强得可怕，绝不似我扶桑武者。”
山本缓缓睁开眼：“她们当然不是扶桑人。若我没看错，那两个女子，都已踏入超凡境。”
屋内几人齐齐色变。
“超凡境？！那我们还等什么？直接动手——”
“愚蠢！”山本冷声打断，“两名超凡，若真动起手来，足以在短时间内毁掉整个矿脉！我们的任务是确保矿脉安全开采，不是和敌人同归于尽！”
他顿了顿，眼中闪过阴鸷：“那小子身份确有蹊跷。令牌或许是真，但人也可能是夺令伪装。为今之计，只有向大本营求援。”
“求援？”疤脸武士一愣，“可此地距大本营足有数千里……”
content_en:
When Village Chief Chen and others exited the room and the footsteps faded away, Jun Ao winked.
Ah Qing understood, and quickly moved around the room, her slender fingers flying like butterflies. She carved obscure runes in the air and engraved them into the walls, floor and door.
Ah Shui took out several small formation flags from his arms and placed them accurately in the four corners of the room.
After a moment, an almost imperceptible layer of light blue halo spread out like water waves, covering the entire room.
"The sound isolation array and early warning array have been set up." Ah Qing breathed a sigh of relief, "Our voices can't be heard outside now. If anyone comes within three feet, the array will also sound a warning."
Ah Shui immediately approached Jun Ao, his eyes widened: "My lord, how on earth did you find out that they are from Fuso? You even imitated other people's words and pretended to be real!"
Huai'an also looked over curiously.
Jun Ao touched his nose and said seriously: "My prince is gifted and has an innate sense of smell for the Japanese. As soon as he entered the village, he felt uncomfortable all over and felt nauseated. How can this be false?"
Ah Qing: "..."
Ah Shui: "..."
Huai'an: "..."
This reason is so outrageous that it is impossible to refute it.
"Okay, let's get down to business." Jun Ao put away his joking expression and lowered his voice, "I have probably guessed why the Japanese chose such a remote village."
He paused and said word by word: "Because there are origin stone veins here."
"Originite vein?!" Ah Shui took a breath of cold air.
Ah Qing's face also became serious: "No wonder... Origin Stone is a top resource for refining high-grade elixirs, casting magic weapons, and even assisting in training. Almost all of the known Origin Stone veins in Dawu are in the hands of the imperial court and several top sects. If the Fuso people are allowed to secretly mine a batch..."
"They will be able to cultivate a large number of high-level ghost warriors in a short period of time." Jun Ao took over the conversation with cold eyes, "The price of invading Dawu will be much smaller by then."
Huai'an clenched his fists: "We must not let them succeed!"
"Of course not." Jun Ao sat down at the table and tapped his fingers on the table, "But fighting head-on is not an option right now. There are two extraordinary realms stationed at the mine. In addition, there must be a lot of ghost warriors guarding the mines, and there are probably several from the ninth realm."
He looked at Ah Shui: "On our side, you and Ah Qing are the only ones who are extraordinary. We may win in a fight, but if the other party jumps over the wall in a hurry and destroys the mine, or if one of us loses money, it won't be worthwhile."
Ah Shui immediately understood: "The prince means... to ask for help?"
"Yes." Jun Ao nodded, "Contact Yingxue with the communication jade token. Tell her about the situation here - Luoxia Village, the Origin Stone Mine, the two Fuso Extraordinaries, and the locations of the four of us. Ask her... to come in person."
Ah Shui did not hesitate and immediately took out a palm-sized, warm and clear jade plaque from his arms.
A ray of true energy gathered at her fingertips, and she quickly moved across the surface of the jade plaque, leaving a faint trace of light.
After the message was written, the jade plaque flashed and returned to its original state.
"The news has been sent out," Ah Shui said.
At the same time, in the main house of the "Village Chief's House" on the other side of the village.
The candlelight flickered, reflecting several gloomy faces.
Village Chief Chen, at this moment he has taken off his disguise, revealing the face of a man in his forties with a short beard.
Kneeling and sitting on the main seat, there are three confidants below.
"Yamamoto-kun, is that boy... really sent by the 'Shadow General'?" A warrior with a scar on his face asked in a low voice, "The token is true, and the Fuso language is pure, but the two women next to him have terrifyingly strong auras, and they are definitely not like me, a Fuso warrior."
Yamamoto slowly opened his eyes: "Of course they are not Fuso people. If I am not mistaken, those two women have already entered the transcendent realm."
Several people in the room changed their expressions.
"Transcendent realm?! Then what are we waiting for? Just do it -"
"Stupid!" Yamamoto interrupted coldly, "If two extraordinary people really take action, they can destroy the entire mine in a short time! IOur mission is to ensure the safe mining of mineral veins, not to die together with the enemy! "
He paused, and a sinister look flashed in his eyes: "That kid's identity is indeed fishy. The token may be real, but the person may also be pretending to be taking the token. For now, the only solution is to ask for help from the base camp. "
"Ask for help? "The scar-faced warrior was stunned, "But this place is thousands of miles away from the base camp..."
